test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow correctly enforces document checks and governance approvals before site activation
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and configured
Test study created in the system
Test user accounts with Site Manager and Governance roles
Sample site activation documents available for upload

test_steps.action: Log in as a Site Manager user and initiate site activation for a test study site
test_steps.expected_result: System presents the site activation workflow with required document checklist

test_steps.action: Upload all required activation documents (protocol, IRB approval, FDA 1572, etc.)
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts documents and updates checklist status to complete

test_steps.action: Submit the site for activation approval through the configured workflow
test_steps.expected_result: System routes the request to governance approvers and updates status to 'Pending Approval'

test_steps.action: Log in as Governance user and approve the site activation request
test_steps.expected_result: System updates site status to 'Activated' and notifies the Site Manager

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow enforces all document requirements
Approval process follows configured governance rules
System correctly updates site status upon completion
All workflow steps are captured in audit trail
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic approvals
ICH E6 R2 requirements for site qualification
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all workflow state changes
Document version control must be maintained
Approval signatures must be electronically recorded

test_cases.test_name: Monitoring Visit Reporting and Follow-up Process
test_cases.objective: Validate that monitoring visit planning, report generation, and follow-up letter creation function according to configured templates and workflows
prerequisites: CTMS system is operational
Test study with activated sites configured
Monitoring visit templates configured
Test user with Clinical Monitor role privileges

test_steps.action: Log in as Clinical Monitor and schedule a monitoring visit for a test site using the planning module
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts visit details and creates visit record with planned date

test_steps.action: Complete the monitoring visit and access the trip report template within the system
test_steps.expected_result: System presents the configured trip report template with all required fields

test_steps.action: Complete the trip report with findings, observations, and action items
test_steps.expected_result: System saves the completed report and generates a follow-up letter using configured templates

test_steps.action: Submit the completed visit report for review and approval
test_steps.expected_result: System routes the report through the configured approval workflow and updates visit status

acceptance_criteria: Monitoring visit planning functions correctly
Trip report templates contain all required elements
Follow-up letters are automatically generated from report data
Approval workflow functions as configured
All visit data is retained per retention policy
regulatory_basis: ICH E6 R2 monitoring requirements
21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance
GCP documentation standards
data_integrity_requirements: Visit reports must be timestamped and electronically signed
All report versions must be retained in audit trail
Follow-up letters must be linked to original visit reports

test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Configuration with Milestone Rules

Test study with payment terms configured
Test sites with subject enrollment data
Test user accounts with Finance role
Payment milestone rules configured in system

test_steps.expected_result: System displays payment dashboard with site payment status and milestones

test_steps.expected_result: System correctly calculates payment amounts based on configured per-subject rates and milestone rules

test_steps.action: Verify tax withholding calculations for applicable sites based on country-specific rules
test_steps.expected_result: System applies correct tax withholding percentages and calculates net payment amounts

acceptance_criteria: Payment calculations match configured milestone rules and rates
Tax withholding is correctly applied based on site location and regulations
Payment reports include all required financial details and calculations
E-signatures and audit trails are properly recorded for payment approvals

Tax regulation compliance for international payments
21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements
data_integrity_requirements: Payment calculations must be accurate and reproducible
Financial records must be immutable once approved
Audit trail must capture all payment-related transactions and approvals

test_cases.test_name: Monitoring Visit Workflow and Follow-up Letter Generation
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured monitoring visit planning, execution, and follow-up letter generation workflows function correctly according to vendor templates and business rules.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is accessible with valid user credentials
Test study and site are created in the system
User has 'Clinical Monitor' role assigned
Monitoring visit templates are configured

test_steps.action: Log into the CTMS with a user account assigned the Clinical Monitor role.
test_steps.expected_result: Successful login and navigation to the monitoring visit planning dashboard.

test_steps.action: Create a new monitoring visit plan for an existing test site, scheduling it for a future date.
test_steps.expected_result: Monitoring visit plan is successfully created and appears in the visit calendar and planning list.

test_steps.action: Complete the monitoring visit by entering findings and observations into the configured trip report template.
test_steps.expected_result: Trip report is saved successfully with all entered data, and the visit status updates to 'Completed'.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entry for report creation

test_steps.action: Generate a follow-up letter using the vendor template, addressing findings from the trip report.
test_steps.expected_result: Follow-up letter is generated correctly, populating the template with visit details and findings, and is available for download or email.

acceptance_criteria: Monitoring visit planning workflow executes without errors
Trip report captures all required data points as per the template
Follow-up letter is generated automatically from the report data
All steps are recorded in the audit trail
regulatory_basis: ICH E6 (R2) - Section 5.18 Monitoring
Company SOP for Clinical Monitoring
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture creation and modification of all visit records and reports
Generated letters must be immutable once finalized and signed

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Milestone and Tax Withholding Configuration
test_cases.objective: Validate the configured payment rules for investigator milestones, including automatic calculation and correct tax withholding based on site location and contractual agreements.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is accessible with valid user credentials
Test study with active sites is configured
Payment milestone rules (e.g., First Subject In, Site Activation) are configured
User has 'Finance Manager' role assigned
Tax rules for different countries/regions are set up

test_steps.action: Log into the CTMS with a user account assigned the Finance Manager role.
test_steps.expected_result: Successful login and access to the financial management module.

test_steps.action: Simulate the achievement of a payment milestone (e.g., 'Site Activation Complete') for a test site located in a country with a standard tax rate.
test_steps.expected_result: System automatically generates a payment request for the correct gross amount upon milestone completion.

test_steps.action: Review the automatically calculated net payment after tax withholding based on the configured rules for the site's country.
test_steps.expected_result: Net payment is calculated correctly by applying the appropriate tax withholding percentage to the gross amount.

test_steps.action: Initiate the approval workflow for the generated payment and complete the e-signature process.
test_steps.expected_result: Payment approval workflow progresses correctly, and the e-signature is applied compliantly, finalizing the payment record.

acceptance_criteria: Payment milestones trigger automatically upon defined study events
Tax withholding is calculated accurately based on site location and rules
Payment approval workflow enforces required signatures
All financial transactions are recorded in the audit trail
regulatory_basis: Financial procedural controls
Internal audit requirements for payment tracking
data_integrity_requirements: Payment calculations must be accurate and reproducible
Audit trail must capture the entire payment lifecycle from trigger to approval
E-signatures must be 21 CFR Part 11 compliant

test_cases.test_name: Integration Testing with EDC System via API
test_cases.objective: Verify that the CTMS successfully integrates with the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system using standard APIs to exchange subject enrollment and visit data.
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and configured
EDC test environment is available
API credentials and endpoints are configured
Test subject and site data exists in both systems

test_steps.action: Create a new subject enrollment record in the EDC system with complete demographic and study assignment data
test_steps.expected_result: Subject enrollment is successfully created in EDC system with unique subject identifier

test_steps.action: Initiate the API synchronization process between EDC and CTMS systems
test_steps.expected_result: Synchronization process completes without errors and shows successful data transfer

test_steps.action: Verify the subject enrollment data appears in the CTMS with correct mapping of all data fields
test_steps.expected_result: Subject record appears in CTMS with identical data to EDC system, including subject ID, site assignment, and enrollment date

test_steps.action: Update subject visit completion status in EDC system and trigger synchronization
test_steps.expected_result: Visit status updates are successfully transferred to CTMS and reflected in subject monitoring dashboard
data_to_capture: Visit status in CTMS after sync

acceptance_criteria: Subject enrollment data is accurately synchronized between systems
API integration handles data transfers without errors
All required data fields are mapped correctly between systems
Synchronization occurs within expected timeframes
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 data integrity requirements
ICH E6(R2) guidelines for data accuracy and reliability
GAMP 5 guidelines for configured product integration
data_integrity_requirements: Data transferred must maintain accuracy and completeness
Audit trail must record all data exchange transactions
Data mapping must be validated for clinical significance
urs_requirements: URS-027-014: Integrate with EDC, eTMF, IRT, and safety systems via standard APIs

test_cases.objective: Verify that the CTMS supports Single Sign-On authentication using SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect protocols for secure user access.
prerequisites: CTMS system is configured with SSO settings
Identity Provider (IdP) test environment is available
Test user accounts are provisioned in IdP
Network connectivity between systems is established

test_steps.action: Configure the CTMS with the Identity Provider's metadata URL and certificate for SAML authentication
test_steps.expected_result: CTMS successfully connects to IdP and validates the SAML configuration without errors

test_steps.action: Attempt to access the CTMS application through the configured SSO portal
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the Identity Provider login page for authentication

test_steps.action: Enter valid credentials on the IdP login page and submit
test_steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and user is redirected back to CTMS with appropriate access permissions

test_steps.action: Verify that user attributes and roles are correctly mapped from IdP to CTMS user profile
test_steps.expected_result: User profile in CTMS reflects correct attributes and role-based permissions from IdP

test_steps.action: Test session management by logging out of CTMS and verifying session termination
test_steps.expected_result: Session is properly terminated and user cannot access CTMS without re-authentication

acceptance_criteria: SSO authentication works seamlessly with both SAML and OIDC protocols
User roles and permissions are correctly mapped from Identity Provider
Session management follows security best practices
Authentication failures are handled gracefully with appropriate error messages
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature requirements
FDA guidance on computer system security
EU Annex 11 requirements for electronic systems
GDPR requirements for user authentication and access control
data_integrity_requirements: Authentication must ensure only authorized users access the system
User identity must be reliably verified through trusted Identity Provider
Access control must enforce role-based permissions consistently
urs_requirements: URS-027-015: Support SSO with SAML/OIDC and provisioning via SCIM
URS-027-007: Enforce role-based access for CRO and sponsor users
